svg.title: From the car to its heat paths
svg.desc: The 2010 2.9 places the engine behind the seats, its principal coolant radiators at the front, and its exhaust treatment and silencers around the rear power unit. The long coolant circuit moves heat forwards. Oil circulates within the engine and exchanges heat with coolant across a metal wall. Exhaust gas follows its own rearward route. Numbered parts: 1 Engine coolant jackets; 2 Oil reservoir and pumps; 3 Oil–coolant exchanger; 4 Pump and thermostat; 5 Front radiators and fans; 6 Long coolant connections; 7 Rear expansion tank; 8 Converters and silencers. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
